items.area: Unguarded import-time external HTTP scraping, sleeps, and disk writes in diagnostic scripts
items.finding: scripts/audit_sources.py (lines 8-78) and scripts/discover_sources.py (lines 15-94) executed top-level network loops across 21+ external URLs (with 40s socket timeouts, 1.0s/0.4s time.sleep delays, .cache/source-audit and .cache/discovery writes, and GitHub ::notice:: workflow commands) whenever imported as Python modules. Because tests/test_d202e156_module_wiring.py::EveryModuleImports imports every identifier-named scripts/*.py module during unittest discovery, every CI and local test run triggered live third-party scraping and multi-minute stalls.
items.handling: Wrapped the executable bodies of scripts/audit_sources.py and scripts/discover_sources.py in def main() -> int: guarded by if __name__ == '__main__': raise SystemExit(main()), keeping python -m scripts.audit_sources in .github/workflows/source-diagnostics.yml unchanged while cutting tests/test_d202e156_module_wiring.py runtime to ~4.0s with zero network side effects. Pinned by tests/test_bf1f9ce5_verification.py.

evidence.detail: Workflow invokes `python -m scripts.audit_sources` (where `__name__ == '__main__'`), which remains 100% preserved after moving top-level network I/O into `main()`.

EveryModuleImports calls `importlib.import_module('scripts.' + stem)` on every valid Python identifier in `scripts/`, previously executing both scripts' live HTTP loops inside `python -m unittest discover`.
